title: fix(plugin-list): a non-grid view's selection bar gates a declared bulk action by its requiredPermissions and visible, through the grid bar's own gate (#30535)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu1CUE4ix29CbZXPy9zCAEqW)_
domain:ui#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWBF1SZ4drR5vh5BSM

Fixes #30535

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/plugin-grid` now exports `useBulkActionItems` (with the `BulkActionItems` and `LegacyBulkActionItem` types its signature names), the grid selection bar's own gate, so `@object-ui/plugin-list` reuses it instead of a second copy. Its `actionDefs` input now reads `readonly BulkActionDef[]`, which accepts every list it accepted before.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：看板、日历、画廊等非表格视图的选择栏，画对象声明的批量操作前先过表格选择栏同一道门：用户不具备 `requiredPermissions` 的不画；被停用的不画；`visible` 按每条选中记录求值，至少一条通过才画。`bulkActions` 里重复的名字只画一个按钮（原来两个按钮同一个 React key）。读不到对象 schema 时的开发态警告，处方句改为点名组件（`ListView` / `ObjectGrid`），不再一律写「the grid」。
- 为什么改：PR #30498 之后非表格选择栏已拿到解析后的操作定义，却只读了标签，于是带权限或 `visible` 条件的操作对所有人、所有选择都显示；表格那边两道门都有。
- 风险与回滚：plugin-grid 入口多导出一个 hook 和两个类型，入参放宽为只读数组；表格选择栏与右键菜单行为不变。服务端动作入口本来就拒绝缺权限的调用（实测 403），本改动只是界面不再画出注定被拒的按钮。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（`nonGridBulkFold` / `nonGridBulkItems` / `nonGridBulkBar` 三段）→ `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`（新导出）→ `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionBar.tsx`（只读入参）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.nonGridBulkGate-30535.test.tsx`，预期 6 条全过；消融门禁时其中 2 条转红，消融去重时 1 条转红。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

ListView draws its own selection bar for every view but the grid. Since #30394 it folds `bulkActions` through plugin-grid's `resolveBulkActions` and so holds each resolved action definition, `requiredPermissions` and `visible` included, but it read only the label. This passes the fold through the grid bar's own gate.

- **`plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`.** The former `nonGridBulkBar` memo is split in three. `nonGridBulkFold` dedupes the names (first occurrence wins; the built-in `delete` is one button whatever its case) and folds them through `resolveBulkActions` exactly as before. `nonGridBulkItems` hands the folded defs to plugin-grid's `useBulkActionItems`, the hook the grid's `BulkActionBar` and its right-click `RowContextMenu` already read: `requiredPermissions` against the caller's held capabilities (`useCapabilityGate`, unknown fails open), the activation switch-off (`isActionSwitchedOff`), and `visible` once per selected record, offered when at least one passes. `nonGridBulkBar` then draws, in authored order, `delete` (its own path, gate and `visibleWhen` subset, unchanged) and each name the gate offers. The undeclared-name warning reads the fold's `undeclared` as before.
- **`plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`.** Exports `useBulkActionItems` and the `BulkActionItems` / `LegacyBulkActionItem` types.
- **`plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionBar.tsx`.** `useBulkActionItems`'s `actionDefs` reads `readonly BulkActionDef[]` (the fold's own return type); the hook only filters it. No behaviour change.
- **`plugin-grid/src/undeclaredActionNames.ts`.** The `unread` prescription says "Give the ListView a data source…" or "Give the ObjectGrid a data source…", from the address's `component`, instead of "Give the grid…".

## Why

The card's first measurement, the run door: `POST /api/v1/actions/OBJECT/ACTION` refuses a declared action whose `requiredPermissions` the caller lacks with 403 before anything dispatches (`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts`, `actionPermissionError`). The existing pins say so on this head: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/http-dispatcher.test.ts -t 'ADR-0066 D4 action requiredPermissions gate'` gives `Tests 5 passed | 246 skipped`. So the gap here is the bar drawing a button the door will refuse, not a door that lets the call through.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.nonGridBulkGate-30535.test.tsx` (gallery view, selection stubbed as in the #30394 test): an action requiring a capability the caller lacks is not drawn; drawn when held; drawn when capabilities are unknown (fail open, the grid's rule); `visible: "record.status == 'closed'"` draws nothing over an open-only selection and draws over a mixed one; `['tag_lead', 'tag_lead', 'delete', 'delete']` draws one of each with no duplicate-key error.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/undeclaredActionNames.test.ts`: the `unread` prescription names `ObjectGrid` by default and `ListView` from the address.

## Acceptance notes

- What the bar dispatches is unchanged and out of scope (the card's "Not in scope", the #30387 review): it still calls the host's `onBulkAction(name, selectedRows)` with the whole selection, where the grid runs a per-record-`visible` def over the passing subset only. The bar now draws such an action only when one selected record passes; which records the host receives is left to that ruling.
- The console's app-shell wires no `onBulkAction` on this bar (`ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559.test.ts` records it as host-runtime, delete only), so in the console a non-delete button here still has no host behind it; unchanged by this PR.

## Verification

All on `9eda24eb` unless stated. Closure: `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/runtime^...' --filter='@object-ui/plugin-list^...' --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' --concurrency=2` (53 tasks, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid build` after the readonly change.
